utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I told Mina I’d bring two toolboxes, the spare drill, a full bit set, and a heavy-duty extension cord, so those should be covered for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s helpful, Gus. Do you know if Mina’s the one keeping the tool list, or should I check in with someone else before I bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mina’s been tracking the supplies, so I’d check with her first before hauling anything over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Kira, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center? Quinn said there’s no sign-up needed, but I’m wondering how crowded it might get.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I heard Tess was still checking details, so I’d like to confirm that Saturday 10 to 2 is official before I plan around it. Did Quinn hear that directly from the organizers?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure if Quinn heard it directly, so I’d feel better if we double-check with Tess before telling everyone. I just don’t want folks hauling broken lamps over there if the time changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, I’m telling folks we’re still gathering repair needs and tool volunteers—if you hear a newer update, can you send it my way?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, absolutely—if I catch wind of anything newer, I’ll send it over to you. I’m still a little fuzzy on the latest myself, so thanks for keeping folks in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Noah—I’ll keep spreading the word for now and let you know if I hear a clearer plan first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m aiming for the repair drive to run 3:30 to 6, and Faye can help set up after school pickup until about 5:30.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — I’ll note the repair drive as 3:30 to 6, with Faye helping setup after school pickup until about 5:30.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Mara — I’ll check in with a couple more folks so we have enough hands for the last half hour after Faye heads out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Dane, right now the first push is the leaky community shed roof and a few porch rails, then I’m helping folks sort out what tools and supplies we actually have.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That sounds like a good order, Cleo. I’ll likely be a bit late, but when I get there I can jump into the tool sorting or help with carrying wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s fine, Dane—when you arrive, check in with me by the shed and I’ll point you toward either the tool table or hauling materials, whichever is backed up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Faye, I’m still waiting on the confirmed date and repair list, but I’m checking with the organizers today and I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — once you hear back, can you let me know if it’s still around 3:30 to 6? I can plan to come right after school pickup and help set up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Faye — I’ll ask them to confirm the time window too, especially whether it’s still around 3:30 to 6, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, I’m slammed right now, but I told Opal I can check the garage and side shed later before she marks them confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo—that’s perfect. Just send Opal and me a quick note once you’ve checked the garage and side shed so we don’t mark them confirmed too early.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll ping you both after I’ve actually checked the garage and side shed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. I’m still waiting on Ira for the confirmed repair list and drop-off spot, so for now just stay ready and I’ll pass it along when I have it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Leo—I’ll stay ready and keep some time open, just let me know when Ira confirms the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m glad I ran into you—there’s a repair drive this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center, no sign-up needed, just bring whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks, Quinn—Rosa had told me they were still gathering requests this week, so I’ll pass along that Saturday’s drop-in is 10 to 2 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Nell—and yes, please spread the word, especially to anyone with small appliances or bikes that need a look.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Eli, I’m keeping the repair drive location list current, but I’m only marking spots confirmed once someone has checked them. Do you have any tools, parts, or drop-off bins you can confirm right now?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Opal—I can confirm my folding table, basic hand tools, extension cord, and two labeled drop-off bins for the 15th at nine.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli — I’ll mark your folding table, hand tools, extension cord, and two labeled drop-off bins as confirmed for the 15th at nine.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hana, I’ve got Gus covering toolboxes, a drill, bits, and an extension cord—what are you bringing, and do we still need a parts table?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina—I’ll bring labels, tape, a clipboard, and spare gloves, but let’s keep the parts table if we don’t yet know which hinges, screws, or patch materials people will need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, bring those, and I’ll keep the parts table on the list. Can you also make a quick sign-in sheet for what each item needs fixed?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oren, have you heard the confirmed repair list and drop-off spot yet? Leo asked me to pass along only the final details, so I don’t want to guess.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh dear, Ira, I don’t want to guess either—I only remember we were aiming for Saturday the 15th at nine, but let me check with Eli or Leo for the confirmed repair list and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Oren—I'll wait for the confirmed word from Eli or Leo before I tell anyone, especially Leo.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
